instruction: Review before running verify_stage_a. Each entry is either (a) an LLM-uncertain merge decision, or (b) a CODE_DEFINITE_DUPLICATE that enriched a BEHAVIORAL statement with inferred fields from an IMPLICIT_TRANSITION. Verify that from_state, to_state, pre_cond, post_cond, and trigger are correct for each kept statement.

entries.warning: REVIEW: enriched N-S011-003 with fields ['to_state', 'pre_cond', 'post_cond'] from D-S011-006 — verify correctness
entries.s1_description: The receiver of a Terminate-Request SHOULD wait for the peer to disconnect, and MUST NOT disconnect until at least one Restart time has passed after sending a Terminate-Ack.
entries.s2_description: The receiver of a Terminate-Request SHOULD wait for the peer to disconnect, and MUST NOT disconnect until at least one Restart time has passed after sending a Terminate-Ack.
entries.s1_pre_cond: endpoint.role = Terminate-Request-receiver & protocol.state = Link Termination Phase & timer.restart_time_elapsed = true

entries.llm_reason: Both statements describe the same SHOULD requirement for retransmitting Terminate-Request packets until a stopping condition is met, from the same section.
entries.s1_description: An implementation wishing to close a connection SHOULD transmit a Terminate-Request. Terminate-Request packets SHOULD continue to be sent until Terminate-Ack is received, the lower layer indicates that it has gone down, or a sufficiently large number have been transmitted such that the peer is down with reasonable certainty.
entries.s2_description: Terminate-Request packets SHOULD continue to be sent until Terminate-Ack is received, the lower layer indicates that it has gone down, or a sufficiently large number have been transmitted such that the peer is down with reasonable certainty.
